title: 12 Best Beirut's Lebanese Meze Restaurants
description: Explore Beirut's top 12 Lebanese meze restaurants for an authentic culinary journey. Discover hidden gems and iconic spots offering the best small plates and traditional flavors.

places.name: Em Sherif Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order There's no à la carte; enjoy the pre-set, ever-flowing menu featuring their exquisite hommos, fattoush, and a variety of hot and cold meze.

places.name: Al Falamanki
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try their 'Fatteh with Laban', 'Mankoushe Saj', and the classic 'Hummus Kawarma'. Don't forget a fresh mint lemonade.

places.name: Liza Beirut
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Kafta with Cherry Sauce' is a standout, alongside innovative meze like 'Beetroot Moutabbal' and 'Fish Nayyeh'.

places.name: Tawlet
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Since the menu changes daily, enjoy the buffet and try a bit of everything! Look for unique regional meze you might not find elsewhere.

places.name: Le Chef
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Moudardara' (lentils and rice), 'Kibbeh Labanieh', and any of their daily specials are excellent. Don't miss the 'Arak' for the full experience.

places.name: Babel Downtown
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Fattoush' is famously fresh, and the 'Ras Asfour with Cherry Sauce' is a delightful blend of sweet and savory. Explore their unique seafood meze options.

places.name: Mayrig
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Mante' (small boat-shaped dumplings in yogurt sauce) and 'Sou Beoreg' (cheese pastries) are absolute must-tries. Also, their 'Itch' (Armenian tabbouleh).

places.name: Kahwet Azmi
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their breakfast meze is fantastic, including 'Foul Medames', 'Balila', and 'Manakish'. For lunch/dinner, try the 'Kebbe Nayyeh' and 'Mixed Grill'.

places.name: Marrouche
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Shish Taouk' and 'Kafta' are staples. Pair them with a variety of their fresh meze like 'Moutabbal' and 'Tabbouleh'.

places.name: Beit Kanz
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Labneh with Thyme', 'Warak Enab b Zeit' (stuffed grape leaves), and seasonal daily specials are always excellent. The focus is on fresh, clean flavors.

places.name: Barbar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Grab a 'Chicken Shawarma' for sure, but also load up on various meze from their extensive display, like 'Tabbouleh', 'Fattoush', and 'Hummus'.

places.name: Enab Beirut
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Kebbeh Traboulsieh' (baked kebbeh) and 'Makanek' (spicy sausages) are excellent. Don't miss their fresh salads and grilled halloumi.
